Subject: Observability alert — telemetry anomaly; need IRP and SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Jonas / Marissa,

We noticed a small spike in model-serving telemetry when FinBridge traffic routed to your hosted endpoint yesterday evening (UTC). Our security team flagged a brief authentication error sequence plus increased request rates to a low-traffic tenant. We don't believe customer data was exfiltrated, but compliance needs a quick handshake.

Can Redwood please provide:
- A brief incident response plan summary (who owns containment/forensics + expected timeline)
- Any available SIG/CAIQ artifact index we can map to our questionnaire (SOC 2 scope point)
- A redacted telemetry sample showing the anomalous window (if shareable under our NDA)

We're preparing a short procurement check (DocuSign link below) to cover scope of artifact transfer. If you have an internal IR contact, please loop them in. We're aiming to confirm within 48 hours for our internal auditors.

Attachments: redacted-telemetry-sample-20260916.zip (partial logs, redacted)

Thanks,
Claire Ho
Security Operations Manager
FinBridge
